title: Consolidated enterprise contract language and pricing guardrails for cross-border data transfers
creator: Amina Patel
description:
Objective: Produce a single playbook and a set of contract clause templates that product, sales, and legal can use when engaging enterprise customers that request special data residency, subprocessors disclosures, retention commitments, or EU/UK transfer safeguards (SCCs, adequacy-based addendum).

Background: Over the last 12 months weve seen a rising number of enterprise RFPs asking for bespoke residency and transfer language plus discounts for long-term reserved capacity. Current responses live in a handful of PRDs, scattered legal snippets, and ad-hoc pricing spreadsheets. This ticket aims to consolidate language, define negotiable pricing guardrails tied to contract commitments (retention, subprocessors, on-prem/dedicated deployment), and create a lightweight questionnaire and checklist for Sales to use during procurement.

Scope:
- Author canonical clauses for: data residency commitments, subprocessors list & notification cadence, retention defaults and maximum retention assurances, EU/UK transfer mechanisms (SCCs, adequacy pathways, derogations), logging/audit data residency, and KMS/HSM controls.
- Produce three contract templates (Standard SaaS Addendum, Dedicated/Private Addendum, On-Prem/Hybrid Exhibit) with variable fields and negotiation guidance.
- Define pricing guardrails and concession matrix (e.g., % discount for 12/24/36 month reserved capacity with required retention/SLA conditions).
- Create a one-page Sales checklist and a short security questionnaire response pack for common SSO/KMS/KPIs questions.
- Deliverables: Confluence playbook, .docx clause templates for Legal, pricing spreadsheet with scenario calculator, and a PRD for follow-up product work if platform changes are required.

Out of scope: Deep legal opinion (Legal to sign off on final wording), full enterprise negotiation (handled case-by-case), and changes that require product engineering > 8 points (those will spawn ENG tickets).
acceptance_criteria: Confluence playbook published and linked from Sales enablement (link added to comments).
Three editable clause templates (.docx) uploaded to Legal templates folder and reviewed by Legal with tracked comments.
Pricing guardrail spreadsheet with scenario calculator validated by Finance and Revenue Ops.
A short security questionnaire pack (answers + evidence links) created and approved by Security to support common RFP questions.
Clear handoff to Engineering for any product changes with created ENG tickets for scope > 8 points.
